# Step 1: start from a clean cart, add the Philips Norelco OneBlade Pro (product_id 2302)
clear_resp = apis.amazon.clear_cart(access_token=amazon_access_token)
print('clear_cart:', clear_resp)
add_resp = apis.amazon.add_product_to_cart(product_id=2302, access_token=amazon_access_token, quantity=1)
print('add_product_to_cart (oneblade):', add_resp)
cart_base = apis.amazon.show_cart(access_token=amazon_access_token)
print('cart_base:', cart_base)

# Clear cart and set up Option A: Amazon gift wrapping for the OneBlade Pro
clear_resp = apis.amazon.clear_cart(access_token=amazon_access_token)
print('clear_cart(A):', clear_resp)
add_oneblade = apis.amazon.add_product_to_cart(product_id=2302, access_token=amazon_access_token, quantity=1)
print('add_oneblade(A):', add_oneblade)
add_gift_wrap = apis.amazon.add_gift_wrapping_to_product(product_id=2302, access_token=amazon_access_token, quantity=1)
print('add_gift_wrapping(A):', add_gift_wrap)
cart_A = apis.amazon.show_cart(access_token=amazon_access_token)
print('cart_A:', cart_A)
option_A_total = cart_A['total_cost']
option_A_gift_fee = cart_A['gift_wrap_fee']
print('option_A_total:', option_A_total, 'option_A_gift_fee:', option_A_gift_fee)

# Option B: buy a gift wrapping item separately (cheapest suitable gift wrap) and wrap it myself.
# 1) Search all pages for gift wrap-related products sorted by lowest price.
all_gift=[]
page_index=0
while True:
    resp = apis.amazon.search_products(query='gift wrap', page_index=page_index, page_limit=20, sort_by='+price')
    if not resp:
        break
    all_gift.extend(resp)
    page_index += 1
    if page_index>50: # safety cap
        break
print('gift wrap search results:', len(all_gift))
# Filter to items whose name/description looks like wrapping material
cands=[]
for p in all_gift:
    name=str(p.get('name','')).lower()
    if 'wrap' in name and ('gift' in name or 'wrapping' in name):
        cands.append(p)
print('cands after name filter:', len(cands))
# Sort by price ascending
cands_sorted=sorted(cands, key=lambda x: x.get('price', float('inf')))
print('top 10 cheapest candidates:')
for p in cands_sorted[:10]:
    print(p.get('product_id'), p.get('name'), p.get('price'))
# Choose cheapest candidate
gift_item=cands_sorted[0] if cands_sorted else None
print('chosen gift_item:', gift_item.get('product_id') if gift_item else None, 'name:', gift_item.get('name') if gift_item else None, 'price:', gift_item.get('price') if gift_item else None)
